query: 环境策略与政策声明 环境策略与政策声明 衡量企业环境战略、政策承诺及治理机制完整性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的环境政策，涵盖全价值链边界；设定了科学的短期与中长期环境目标；明确了董事会及高管层的专项职责，且披露了明确的政策审议与修订频率。 • 1分（合格）：发布了正式的环境政策声明，包含基础的管理目标和职责分配，但在政策边界描述、目标的科学性或董事会实质性参与方面披露不足。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式环境政策披露，或仅有碎片化的环保措施描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：环境政策覆盖 >80% 的业务单元、子公司、生产基地及核心经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅适用于集团总部/部分区域，或未说明政策在全集团的推行范围。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 环境政策 环境策略 环境管理体系 政策边界 董事会环境监督 政策审议频率 集团环境政策 ISO 14001 EMS environmental policy environmental strategy environmental management system policy boundary board oversight of environment policy review frequency group-wide environmental policy ISO 14001 EMS 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '环境策略与政策声明'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散环保项目；仅有排放数据表；仅有合规许可证列表；仅有“绿色发展”口号；仅有ISO 14001证书或EMS名称而无正式环境政策、管理目标和职责分配。区分：本指标关注企业环境政策、目标、职责、审议机制及覆盖；供应商环境标准关注供应链准入；ESG监督委员会是治理架构。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: GREEN OPERATIONS / 綠色營運
results.text: In the procurement process, the Group attaches great importance to the negative environmental impact of products and the environmental performance of our suppliers. Therefore, we are committed to implementing a green procurement strategy and offering the priority for considering the application of suppliers with ISO 14001 certification. The Group clearly sets out its requirements in the contracts. Suppliers must undertake and ensure that their production, sales, transportation and after-sales activities are in compliance with national environmental and occupational health and safety management requirements. Supplier assessment and project review are conducted on a semi-annual basis to review suppliers' commitment to environmental protection and their employment of environmentally friendly equipment and measures. Meanwhile, we strengthen our communication with suppliers and actively convey the Group's advocacy and support for green procurement.

results.text: Protecting our planet for the long-term sustainability of our business and communities is critical. Singamas is committed to being a responsible corporate citizen, managing its carbon footprint, actively control carbon emissions, continuously optimising the use of resources, and to strengthen the management of pollutant and emission. We continue to innovate and promote effective environmental protection projects and measures to minimise the impact from the production process and the entire industrial chain activities on the environment and communities. At the same time, we will do our best to provide the market with high-efficiency and high-quality green products through the research and development of new technologies and products, so as to improve the environmental performance of the value chain, and strive to meet the goal of 'carbon neutrality'.
